messages:
elaine.x: Quick sync — we need a final validation pack for the Acme pilot. Exec review Friday, so can we lock success criteria by Wednesday?

samir.k: On it. Which surface are we prioritizing? generation latency vs retrieval accuracy?

jordan_se: Main ask from Acme is 'reply drafting' quality + extraction accuracy for invoice fields. Latency target < 400ms p50 for 1k qps sim.

marta_p: Agree. Let's scope three golden flows: 1) invoice field extraction (structured) 2) canned reply generation (turn-key) 3) semantic search highlight for similar tickets.

elaine.x: +1. For each flow we need: golden dataset (50–100 examples), scoring rubric, pass/fail gates, and a regression check set.

ben_solutions: Drafting a proposed scorer: combination of exact-match for key fields, normalized F1 for entities, and human QA score for generation. My baseline JSON for scorer config:

```json
{
  "flows": {
    "invoice_extraction": { "weights": { "field_exact": 0.6, "field_f1": 0.3, "human": 0.1 } },
    "reply_generation": { "weights": { "qa_human": 0.7, "semantic_sim": 0.3 } },
    "semantic_search": { "weights": { "mrr": 0.8, "human": 0.2 } }
  },
  "thresholds": { "invoice_extraction": 0.85, "reply_generation": 0.78, "semantic_search": 0.7 }
}
```

samir.k: That looks reasonable. Two notes: 1) semantic_sim should use cosine on embeddings from model variant we plan to serve. 2) Add a token-latency penalty to the score so heavy prompt cost is visible.

jordan_se: For regression gates: snapshot golden set + daily smoke on 200 seeded prompts. If any flow drops >3% absolute vs baseline, fail. Also require manual signoff for model switch.

marta_p: Timeline check: Golden sets ready by Tue EOD, scorer config locked Wed morning, run baseline harness Wed afternoon, deliver results Thu. Is that doable?

elaine.x: Need price/cost note for customer: estimate 3x dev hours for harness + two dedicated runs on Dedicated tier for baseline. Samir — can you attach cost estimate?

samir.k: Rough calc: harness infra + runs ~= $2.4k for baseline experiments (GPU hours + storage). Dedicated reserve for pilot peak adds ~$6k/mo if they want committed throughput. I'll DM line items.

ben_solutions: Security Q: Acme asked about data retention for golden datasets. We should store goldens in customer-scoped bucket with KMS, and only keep model outputs for 30 days. That satisfies their compliance team per prior SSO thread.

inc-bot: Note: security questionnaire from Acme updated 2026-02-12 09:14 — see link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-SEC-1

jordan_se: Action items: 1) Ben to finalize scorer JSON and example eval scripts. 2) Marta to collate golden examples and annotation schema. 3) Samir to provide infra + cost note. 4) Elaine to confirm pass thresholds with customer PM.

elaine.x: I'll ping Acme PM now for thresholds and sample data. If we miss Wed lock, we push exec review to next week. :crossed_fingers:

ben_solutions: Uploading initial harness snippets to the sales shared folder now: /shared/sales/acme/harness/ (will include runner, scorer, and human QA template).

samir.k: One more: include a canary rollout plan in harness — fallback to smaller model if latency or cost exceeds target during live pilot.

marta_p: Copy. I'll add canary steps into the acceptance matrix.

elaine.x: Thanks everyone — followups in this thread.
